5. The learned Assistant Judge considering the evidence on record and the unregistered kabala Ext. I also found that there has been interpolation as regard the date of execution of the said unregistered kabala, and as it appeared that in Ext. l in case of Bengali year 1385 BS the figure 5 has been inserted by way of eraser interpolation and so also in the English date of the year 1970 the figure 7 has been inserted by interpolation. Consequently the date of execution appeared to be fabricated. Thus the trial Court dismissed the suit. On appeal the learned Subordinate Judge took the view that since last refusal was made in the last part of Magh, 1386 BS corresponding to February, 1979 and that being the cause of action of the suit and the suit having been filed on 21-1-1982 within 3 years from that date the suit is not barred by limitation. The finding arrived at by the Trial Court as to the interpolation of the date of execution of the deed Ext. 1 has not been reversed by the Appellate Court considering the materials on record. The Appellate Court, however, decreed the suit with the aforesaid finding that the suit is not barred by limitation. 

 6. Md Serajul Huq, the learned Advocate for the petitioner, has submitted that the trial Court was justified in its finding that the suit is barred by limitation and that the plaintiff is not entitled to any decree for Specific Performance of Contract as they have not come before the Court with clean hands since the date of execution was found to have been fabricated by way of eraser and interpolation by the plaintiff.
